# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.11 — Full audit hardening

<!-- update-summary: Preview.11 closes the high-risk Smart Drag/OLE, encrypted-share quota, output-safety, and asynchronous-lifecycle findings from the full audit while preserving the Windows 10/11 compatibility contract. -->

Preview.11 is the full-audit hardening Preview. It keeps the Preview.10
behavioral contracts and narrows the remaining risk at native-thread,
cross-process-share, output-file, and shutdown boundaries.

## Smart Drag and OLE safety

- Smart verification re-reads the live cursor immediately before creating the
  ephemeral OLE probe, re-resolves the monitor, and revalidates the active
  mode/session/policy. A cursor-read failure fails closed.
- Probe watchdogs only request owner-thread completion/cleanup. OLE revoke and
  HWND destruction remain owner-thread operations, including queue-failure and
  timeout paths.
- Drag observer shutdown is asynchronous and bounded; the UI thread does not
  synchronously join the hook thread or wait on the signal processor.
- The existing intentional double-dispose native smoke contract remains in
  place.

## Encrypted Internet Share

- Revoke handles are encrypted with current-user DPAPI and restored at startup,
  so a restart does not discard the user's only authenticated revoke control.
- The reference Cloudflare Worker uses a Durable Object coordinator for
  concurrency-safe aggregate plaintext-byte and item accounting. Manifest size,
  chunk size, chunk ordering, duplicate objects, and token claims are checked
  server-side.
- Revocation marks the coordinator first and paginates R2 deletion. Missing
  Durable Object configuration fails closed. 404/410 revoke responses are
  treated as already revoked so local credentials can still be retired.
- Receiver pages use a per-response CSP nonce instead of unsafe inline script
  and style policy.

The reference Worker remains an explicit deployment. Configure the
SHARE_COORDINATOR Durable Object binding and migration in
share-worker/wrangler.toml.example, keep R2 lifecycle expiry enabled, and
review the account/network policy before deployment.

## Quick Actions and file safety

- Windows reserved device names, trailing dots/spaces, control characters,
  and long export stems are sanitized before atomic CreateNew reservation.
- Hash, QR, ZIP, image, and metadata actions share best-effort cleanup for
  files created by the current operation only.
- ZIP entry names are made unique before archive creation.
- Encoded image output is written directly to the reserved destination file,
  avoiding both a second full-size managed byte array and an in-memory encoded
  stream.

## Task ownership and shutdown

- Startup update checks, close-to-tray dialogs, incoming transfer
  notifications, search/thumbnail/undo refreshes, pairing expiry, detector
  grace/timeout tasks, and projection workers now have explicit ownership or
  awaited completion paths.
- DNS-SD and file logging shutdown paths use asynchronous disposal; expected
  cancellation/cleanup failures remain classified separately from operation
  failures.
- Main Page setting persistence uses a shared, narrow helper while both Main
  Page and Dynamic Island continue to use the same Quick Action registry,
  capability, parameter, and result path.

## Validation boundary

The hosted Windows CI remains authoritative for Core/Infrastructure tests,
the WinUI build, Portable EXE, Installer, unsigned MSIX, lifecycle smoke,
checksums, update manifest, and website/API synchronization. The Worker
coordinator has a Node syntax check and regression tests in CI.

This Preview is **CONDITIONAL** until hands-on evidence covers Windows 10
1809, Windows 10 22H2, Windows 11, mixed-DPI multi-monitor placement,
native border leaks, Explorer/provider cursor feedback, Smart Drag false
reveals, and the full Quick Action parameter/error matrix. Static contracts
and hosted Windows CI do not replace those cells.

## 中文说明

- Smart Drag 在创建 OLE 探针前重新读取实时光标、重新解析显示器并校验当前会话与策略；读取失败时保持 fail-closed。
- OLE 探针 watchdog 只请求 owner thread 完成和清理；撤销 OLE、销毁 HWND 不会由错误线程直接执行。拖拽观察器关闭改为异步有界等待。
- Internet Share 撤销凭据使用当前用户 DPAPI 加密持久化并在启动时恢复；Worker 使用 Durable Object 原子记账总明文字节数和条目数，撤销会分页清理 R2。
- Receiver CSP 使用每次响应的 nonce，导出文件名处理 Windows 保留设备名、尾随空格/点、控制字符和超长 stem；图像编码输出分块写入，避免第二份完整托管字节数组。
- 启动更新检查、关闭提示、入站传输通知、搜索/缩略图/撤销刷新、配对过期、Smart Drag 定时任务和 projection worker 均明确持有、取消或等待。
- 本 Preview 仍为 **CONDITIONAL（有条件完成）**：真实 Windows 10 1809/22H2、Windows 11、混合 DPI、多显示器、边框泄漏、Explorer/提供程序光标反馈和完整 Quick Action 矩阵证据仍需实机补齐。

Stable-channel users will not receive this Preview. Select the Preview
channel only to test the audit hardening behavior.
